node.label: West Asia: Iran war & Hormuz
node.summary: The Iran war, the Strait of Hormuz blockade and the Houthis.

facts.text: India link: Hormuz carries much of India's oil and LNG; the war hit Qatar LNG supplies and airline fuel costs.
facts.plain: India link: Hormuz carries much of India's oil and LNG; the war hit Qatar LNG supplies and airline fuel costs.

facts.text: Yemen's **Houthis** claimed a drone attack on Saudi Arabia's **Dammam airport**.
facts.plain: Yemen's Houthis claimed a drone attack on Saudi Arabia's Dammam airport.

facts.text: Iran's Foreign Minister: **Abbas Araghchi**; spokesman: **Esmaeil Baqaei**.
facts.plain: Iran's Foreign Minister: Abbas Araghchi; spokesman: Esmaeil Baqaei.

facts.text: Iran says it can reopen the **Strait of Hormuz** within two days if the US meets its terms. Hormuz has been blockaded since the war began in **February 2026**.
facts.plain: Iran says it can reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if the US meets its terms. Hormuz has been blockaded since the war began in February 2026.

facts.text: Iran warned that any renewed war with the US 'could last longer' than the previous round, after President Trump said he had to 'take care of' more targets; Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a future conflict would have 'no geographic limitations'.
facts.plain: Iran warned that any renewed war with the US 'could last longer' than the previous round, after President Trump said he had to 'take care of' more targets; Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a future conflict would have 'no geographic limitations'.

facts.text: Iran's Supreme Leader **Mojtaba Khamenei** (in charge since March after his father **Ali Khamenei** was killed in US-Israeli strikes) warned of a 'geographically unrestricted' response; Trump is weighing action after the **US midterms**, and Netanyahu spoke of a chance to topple Tehran. Armed forces chief: **Ali Abdollahi**; IRGC: **Ahmad Vahidi**.

facts.text: **Oman** rescued 25 sailors from the burning Panama-flagged ship **RITI**; Iran halted three tankers. Tehran has restricted traffic in the **Strait of Hormuz** since the West Asia war began on **28 Feb 2026**.
facts.plain: Oman rescued 25 sailors from the burning Panama-flagged ship RITI; Iran halted three tankers. Tehran has restricted traffic in the Strait of Hormuz since the West Asia war began on 28 Feb 2026.

facts.text: Iran's IRGC said **four tankers** caught fire after hitting **mines** in the **Strait of Hormuz**, a day after the US said it had demined key routes.
